Plants as Carbon Dioxide Fixers
¨From figure:¨CC reactions multiplied by 3¤For every 3 turns of the Calvin Cycle, 5 molecules of G3P used to reform 3 molecules of RuBP , allowing the cycle to continue¤5x3C in G3P = 3X5C in RuBP
explanation: To maintain a continuous cycle, the Calvin cycle must regenerate RuBP. In terms of stoichiometry, for every 3 turns of the cycle (which fixes 3 molecules of CO2), 5 molecules of the 3-carbon compound G3P (glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate) are used to reform 3 molecules of the 5-carbon compound RuBP (ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate). This chemical rearrangement balances mathematically: 5 molecules of 3-carbon G3P (15 total carbons) are converted back into 3 molecules of 5-carbon RuBP (15 total carbons).

questions.q: How many molecules of G3P are required to regenerate 3 molecules of RuBP in the Calvin cycle?
questions.exp: The notes state: 'For every 3 turns of the Calvin Cycle, 5 molecules of G3P used to reform 3 molecules of RuBP, allowing the cycle to continue' (5x3C in G3P = 3X5C in RuBP).
